rows.title: [Bug]: Desktop queue panel shows the previous session's queued prompt in a new chat — display-only, storage binding correct
[Bug]: Desktop: pending clarify card vanishes on session re-entry — turn strands unanswerable until stopped, renders "Result unavailable"
[Bug]: SenseNova Provider Issues — Follow-up HTTP 400 and Custom Connection Rejects API Key After Saving
[Bug]: A2A inbound silently rejects all peers (403) when bound to 0.0.0.0 and no trusted peers configured
[Bug]: hermes update --check reports "api.github.com did not answer within 10 seconds" on a source install when the proxy cold TLS handshake exceeds the hard-coded 10 s ceiling
[Bug]: ACP session/set_model ignores the provider: prefix on the gateway path - cross-provider model picks 404 or are silently ignored
Gateway fixes (#134889), package 4: messaging bots, cron and Kanban workers
Gateway fixes (#134889), package 3: Ink TUI and Desktop sessions, commands and live events
Gateway fixes (#134889), package 2: session creation, model picks and credentials
Gateway fixes (#134889), package 1: classic CLI
[Feature]: Session-scoped audio-only reply modality, switchable by explicit request (text default, no caption/streamed text)
Kanban workers send an empty API key for anthropic_messages providers other than Anthropic (custom providers, MiniMax): `Illegal header value b'Bearer '`
[Bug]: v0.22.0 — `hermes` exits immediately with a bare "Error: invalid_params" when a configured MCP server is unreachable (gateway session.create rejects config-resolved toolsets)
[Feature]: Make the watch_patterns lifetime budget configurable (default stays 8)
[Bug]: IRC bot never reconnects after a silent network drop and stays deaf until restart
[Bug]: Discord durable re-authorization ignores platforms.discord.allowed_roles, dropping role-authorized messages with permission_denied
[Feature]: Unified pre-egress authorization hook for standalone plugins
[Feature]: Public per-turn authorization and revocation contract for plugins
[Feature]: Public passive group-event subscription for standalone plugins
Desktop: messaging platform forms can't set slash-command admins (allow_admin_from is config.yaml-only)
Discord/bot-mailbox receipts with status ambiguous from permission_denied are rejected as unknown receipt schema on every gateway scan
Feature request: option to restore pre-v0.22 auto topic transfer (root-DM message opens a new session in a freshly created topic)
[Bug]: Discord async child completes but durable result stays pending and parent does not resume
Plugin registration race: seven platform plugins fail with "dictionary changed size during iteration" at startup
hermes gateway status blocks for minutes in a pending-tail state, and the Desktop error recommends it
Windows: interrupted source-update auto-repair loops on every launch (sync-stage failures bypass the retry counter; marker reclaim does not clear the pending obligation)
Model-switch timeline notice is a hardcoded English 'model changed' — not localized, and discards the new model/provider the backend already provides

Desktop model picker permanently loses the current-selection checkmark once composer localStorage is dirty — no self-heal, 'Refresh models' is a dead end, users cannot verify which endpoint receives traffic
fix(plugins): bind the owning profile's secret scope before native plugin registration/background workers
[Bug]: Streaming STT resampler adds samples when 44.1 kHz audio arrives in chunks
[Feature]: Bot role label: a short job title beside the bot's name, separate from Title and Description
Desktop: mouse wheel does not scroll the mcp.json editor in the connector Advanced pane (scrollbar drag only)
[Bug]: Hermes Desktop fails to launch from Ubuntu app launcher
Reactions fail with 'unknown method: message.react' on all ticketed WS connections (desktop app included) — authority dispatch never registered message.react
Desktop updater: stable channel always offers v0.22.2 to git installs on main, then fails with exit 1 (refusal surfaced as 'Failed to update')
[Feature]: Supported read-back of installed-skill provenance (source URL, revision, files, install path)
[Bug]: stable update 10s merge-base probe times out even when both commits are local (partial clone, commit-graph writes disabled)
[Bug]: on Windows, an update fails when the live Hermes holds a tools entry directory (WinError 5 on rename)
[Bug]: the update check reads no credentials when its environment doesn't carry <hermes home>/.env — anonymous quota, 403s
[Bug]: hermes update aborts the whole run on a single transient git fetch failure
[Bug]: a gateway worker under a Python 3.14 runtime inherits a legacy hermes-agent/venv (cp311) site-packages from sys.path and dies on pydantic_core
[Bug]: the Windows named-pipe peer check refuses a short-lived ensure child — OpenProcess can't read an exited peer's SID, so boot-time auto-starts are rejected
[Bug]: gateway ensure can never verify an installed Scheduled Task on a localized Windows host (cp936 XML/CSV + XML default elision)
[Bug]: profile-scoped /api/status reports a multiplexed profile's Telegram as disconnected (Desktop shows "telegram down")
[Feature]: OAuth route for plugins that call a third-party API with the user's own OAuth client
[Bug]: Bot sessions can no longer be seen or managed from the Sessions sidebar — hiding is intentional (always-hidden sweep), but no replacement management surface exists
ACP: option to request permission for every tool call (terminal included)
[Bug] Chinese voice chat is unusable: STT hard-locked to language=en with no auto-detect, and TTS defaults to an en-US voice for Chinese text
Bedrock Converse/ConverseStream: plugin-registered tool schemas with top-level allOf/anyOf/oneOf fail ValidationException
execute_code: a nested tool call outlives its cell and applies a protected-file write after the cell timed out
[Bug]: Pasting an image fails with invalid_params in a non-default profile (attachment staged in the default profile's cache)
[Bug]: Multiplexed gateway: a secondary profile's Desktop chat runs the profile default instead of its model pick once the primary profile has a local session
Bug report — Hermes desktop: UI freezes / stops accepting clicks while the agent drives an iPhone via Device Hub (recovers after minimize+restore)
`hermes -c` / `--resume latest` lands on empty launch stubs in 0.22.1 — empty rows are never discarded and gateway-hosted chats are invisible to the CLI's MRU lookup
[Bug] Orphan gateway_routing entries can never be pruned, and the Desktop 404 delete failure never names its target
[Bug]: every plain message to the default profile is refused with RuntimeStoreError(invalid_params) when gateway.multiplex_profiles is true (v0.22.1)
fix(gateway): restart drain waits the full cap on a turn blocked on user approval/clarify while Desktop is refused
[Bug]: /retry from a messaging platform fails with RuntimeStoreError(invalid_params) when multiplex_profiles is on
`hermes chat -q` fails with `GatewayRPCError: invalid_params` (session.create)
[Bug]: Kanban managed worker dies with WorkerPersistenceError: synchronous_rpc_on_event_loop
[Feature]: durable plugin turn admission, automation provenance and writer-release receipts
[Bug]: Desktop onboarding with Google AI Studio key keeps OpenRouter base_url → 401 shown as "Google AI Studio rejected your API key"
[Bug]: Desktop treats messaging-channel sessions as local: WeChat completions count as unread, and opening a WeChat session raises "Session controls unavailable: stale_generation" (v0.22.1)
[Bug]: Desktop statusbar context gauge / cache-hit / tokens-per-second never populate on unified-gateway sessions — session.usage payload shape mismatch (v0.22.1)
[Bug]: Desktop model picker loses the current-model checkmark on unified-gateway sessions — session.info carries no provider field (v0.22.1)
[Bug]: Windows gateway identity check can never pass — RunLevel compared against the schema spelling (element stripped by schtasks), missing <Enabled> read as disabled
[Bug]: post-update state.db auto-restore picks the oldest matching snapshot, not the newest — and prints "Auto-restore did not complete" after the live DB has already been replaced
[Bug]: blocking heartbeat file touch on the gateway event loop stalls the owner; managed workers die with owner_unavailable
Anthropic "Current session" usage shows 100% when real usage is ~1%
[Bug]: Desktop group creation always fails with `invalid_params` — service only knows own profile
[Bug]: Auto-title requests drop provider auth headers (e.g. `api-key`) — session titles 401 on header-auth gateways
[Bug]: Unset plugin secret field is invisible in the dark theme (Settings ▸ Plugins ▸ Agent settings)
[Bug]: Kanban turns run by the profile owner are not finite — approvals hang for approvals.timeout and the card blocks

Docker image ships no payload `manifest.json`, so every `runtime_command`-spawned action (skill install, MCP install, doctor, backup) dies with "no dependency environment is committed for this install"
[Bug]: kanban per-profile cap never sets capacity_full, so false "dispatcher stuck" telemetry persists (PR #131755 head)
Compaction boundary re-arms read dedup but not the tool guardrail, so the post-compaction re-read is refused
perf: memoise Path.resolve() in get_active_profile_name / _plugin_home_key / local env PATH (≈21% of CPU in tool-heavy turns, ≈75% of each CLI redraw)
CLI pins a CPU core at 100% while idle when the terminal is 3 rows or fewer (FooterSplit heal-redraw loop)
Background review fork inherits the turn's fallback runtime, so a one-off failover keeps billing the fallback provider after the turn ends
ACP: provider errors (e.g. HTTP 429 after router retries) are not surfaced to the client
Upgrade breaks inherited ACLs on %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\tools\* — desktop backend fails to spawn ("Access is denied")
Gateway surfaces: a chat-executable restart command so the stale-guard refusal has a reachable remedy
[Bug]: OpenCode Go `hy4-preview` — the model picker offers it, the session.create gate refuses it (curated-catalog drift)
[Bug]: Open Setup Guide Link
[Bug]: Desktop Bot Mode rewrote 4 profiles' profile.yaml at once, clearing group membership (group: null / groups: []) without a user ungroup
[Bug]: Desktop: changing reasoning effort repeatedly fails with `stale_generation` ("模型选项更新失败") — retained `session.mutate` keeps a stale `expected_generation`
[Bug]: hermes acp + per-task HERMES_HOME (Multica overlay homes): session/new fails with "Gateway inaccessible: not_ready" — no local-session fallback on 0.22.1
[Bug]: Hermes docker no longer start
session_authority._handle crashes with TypeError when a live in-memory session's DB row is deleted — breaks every session.list call
[Bug]: Background process completion notifications fail delivery to Discord and spin in infinite retry injection loop
Kanban dispatcher kills worker PID from DB without verifying process identity (PID reuse can hit an unrelated process)
hermes update permanently fails on blob:none partial clone: stable channel probe lazy-fetches and self-deadlocks at its own 10s timeout
[Bug]: Desktop — composer queue entries duplicate, cannot be deleted, and reappear minutes after clearing
Codegen: strategy drift between sample-size run and full-batch run makes batch tasks  unreliable
Public subagent lifecycle re-truncates native summaries and drops spill recovery metadata
Dashboard mutations refused 409 while a gateway owns state.db (bulk actions always fail)
session.list crash-loops when a live session's DB row is gone (TypeError in session_authority._handle)
Dashboard mutations (delete/rename/pin/model) silently fail on any non-secure origin
[Bug]: adopt_legacy_session drops row['model_config'] provider/base_url/reasoning — resumed pre-v0.22.1 sessions route model to wrong provider (HTTP 404)
[Bug]: groups.log violates its wire contract — RoomActor is missing profile/display_name/connection_id
[Bug]: Microsoft Store Windows install stuck on Connecting — ticket bridge passes Python flags to hermes.exe
[Bug]: Legacy remote session edits fetch mutation-snapshot locally while PATCH goes to the remote
[Bug]: macOS update corrupts dashboard respawn argv and misattributes restart follow-ups
[Bug]: /memory approve|reject|approval refused as unsupported_command on desktop/local sessions — _CONTROL_ARGUMENTS has no memory entry
[Feature]: Public plugin hook for response validation and custom failover classification
[Bug]: Mattermost text posts refused with invalid_params by native admission (media_urls=None)
npm vulnerabilities flagged by hermes doctor — missing overrides for minimatch, jsdom, undici, vitest, yaml
kanban: a running worker cannot hand its task to another profile (assign raises, reassign --reclaim kills the caller, no agent tool)
[bug]: memory setup stringifies list/dict defaults; accepting mnemosyne sync_roles default silently disables capture
Desktop chat model switch fails: session.mutate crashes with AuthError "provider 'custom' resolved without credentials" for local-DM sessions of secondary profiles
[Bug]: TUI can't start or recover its gateway on a source install: gateway_bootstrap.py dies with No module named 'ruamel'
Cron run can sit "waiting for non-streaming API response" for hours without the inactivity guard ending it
Gateway boot crash: unguarded chmod(0o700) in bot_live_delivery._locked() aborts startup on Windows ACL anomaly
Let plugins attach validation state to skills in the dashboard catalog
Terminal environment providers: process lifecycle, resolved scope for policy hooks, and goal gates
Session lifecycle seams: refuse a turn before it starts, check a resume, and set the end reason
Plugin hook when a profile is created, before it becomes visible
Automation blueprints: add a url slot type and let a plugin keep its own key
ctx.dispatch_tool and ctx.call_mcp skip pre_tool_call and tool_execution middleware
[Bug]: cron .sh scripts that call python get the bare store Python since v0.21.6 (store-first PATH from pm.activate())
Public subagent lifecycle handles stop working after parent-session rotation
plugins: register_skill accepts a directory, stores it, and skill_view later fails with EISDIR
[Bug][TUI] /model picker fails with "unsupported canonical model option: --reasoning" on the shared gateway
[Bug]: Desktop (local viewer) final replies can get the messaging-platform 💭 Reasoning projection prepended after the unified gateway runtime
[Bug]: a local session.create `provider` override keeps the profile's stale model.base_url — the new provider's key is sent to the old provider's endpoint (401)
[Bug]: Desktop Kanban delivery policy and lifecycle gaps (notify/wake, compaction, attention events)
[Bug]: CLI /sessions always empty — placeholder first-write stamps created_source='unknown', which escapes the SurfaceLabelReader compat filter
Public subagent lifecycle cannot carry native images or output-schema contracts
Deleting a non-root profile's session always 409s: runtime_coordination_required (store._routing_db vs authority.db)
Cron preflight reports 'provider credential missing' for a rate-limited Anthropic credential (is_rate_limited_auth_error is codex-only)
[Bug]: Model switch confirmed but not committed — TUI note/picker show the new model while the session keeps serving the old one
[Bug]: agent cron runs on the unified runtime get local-* session ids; run history still scans cron_{job_id}_* so the desktop run rows become unclickable
[Bug]: Kanban TUI notification silently dropped when a non-owning backend (dashboard Chat) claims it and its wake-up is refused SESSION_NOT_OWNED
Add a strict release mode that reports or refuses unproven client and state teardown
Option to stop replaying reasoning from finished turns
TUI gateway starts a second notification poller on agent rebuild and orphans the first
Skills hub install: per-request quarantine, cross-process install lock, and per-profile dashboard actions
Let managed scope force shared-metrics sending off
Add a provider lock that forbids every fallback provider and credential swap
Provider plugins with their own client can't start without an API key and base_url
Expose max_result_size_chars and dynamic_schema_overrides on ctx.register_tool
Single-query (-q) turns get a new random task_id on every call
execute_code tool calls and their connector batch entries have no distinct tool_call_id
browser_tool_session: redact daemon output, and let a provider opt out of the local Chromium fallback
Browser idle cleanup can close a session that became active after it was picked
kanban: a max_retries=0 card is respawned after a rate-limited run
[Bug]: TUI session list never loads (TypeError in session_authority._handle) after `hermes sessions delete` removes a live-registered session - every `session.list` crashes until gateway restart
Telegram: messages held across a disconnect are replayed out of order
[Bug]: Desktop boot fails with `Gateway starting (deadline)` when the sticky active_profile is a parked profile — regression after update
desktop: composer model switch silently fails (session_busy / revision_conflict) until a session-level operation
